function.name: electric_field_calculate
function.description: Calculate the electric field based on the amount of charge and distance from the charge Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Q.description: The amount of charge in coulombs. This is a float type value.

r.description: The distance from the charge in meters. This is a float type value.

function.name: magnetic_field_calculate
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field based on the current flowing and the radial distance using Ampere’s law Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

I.description: The electric current flowing in Amperes.

r.description: The radial distance from the line of current in meters. This is a float type value.

function.name: electric_force_calculate
function.description: Calculate the electric force between two charges at a distance Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Q1.description: The amount of the first charge in coulombs. This is a float type value.

Q2.description: The amount of the second charge in coulombs. This is a float type value.

r.description: The distance between the two charges in meters. This is a float type value.
